description: This file defines a REST controller named HelloController in a Spring Boot application. It provides several HTTP GET endpoints: '/' for a welcome message, '/docs' to redirect to Swagger UI documentation, '/health' for health status, and '/api/info' for application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A Spring Boot REST controller providing basic endpoints for a business loan API, including a welcome message, documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Builds and redirects to the Swagger UI documentation page, preserving request scheme, host, and port.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Returns a string indicating the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides basic information about the application.
